scope: Reporting details fixed before opening official ADE validation; original protocol/config unchanged
primary_comparisons: 8: 2 MAC budgets x 2 rank definitions x low-vs-random or low-vs-uniform; paired fine-tune seeds
intervals: Student t with df=2, familywise 95% Bonferroni over 8; zero sample SD does not establish a zero-width interval
hardware_quality_filter: At least 99% mean source mIoU is descriptive, not a non-inferiority test
training_limit: 1500 updates x batch 8 / 17650 samples = 0.680 epochs; convergence is not assumed
reporting_changes: Added recovery curves, confusion-count consistency, report arithmetic checks, and standalone startup guard; active training implementation unchanged
